item.title: Northern Lights Foundation honors Duluth East graduate with legacy grant
item.description: The Northern Lights Foundation announced the new Shimia Nord Legacy Grant, an annual $5,000 grant to honor the life and inspirational spirit of Shimia Nord, a Duluth East High School graduated who died of cancer in September 2025 at the age of 18.

item.description: With the offseason officially underway, UMD women's hockey has already begun to experience some changes to its roster. Backup goalie Sophia Villanueva is transferring to Bemidji State while defenseman Kamdyn Davis is headed to Northeastern.

item.title: US attacks Iranian nuclear site while Tehran hits oil tanker off the Dubai coast
item.description: The United States has hit the central Iranian city of Isfahan, sending a massive fireball into the sky, and Tehran struck a fully loaded Kuwaiti oil tanker in the Persian Gulf. The attacks Tuesday were testament to the sustained intensity of the monthlong war the U.S. and Israel launched against Iran.
